load_scene_database: load scene metadata from YAML database files for train and validation splits
generate_clip_embeddings: generate JinaCLIP image embeddings for scene color frames using jina-clip-v1 model
process_scene_frames: process scene color frames into normalized CLIP embeddings with distributed inference
gather_distributed_embeddings: gather per-rank scene embeddings across distributed processes and combine into a single map
save_scene_embeddings: save combined scene-object-frame CLIP embeddings to a PyTorch checkpoint file
